newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks power ahead, fuelled by banks.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks power ahead, fuelled by banks.

text.p: MADRID, July 9 (Reuter) 1300 GMT - Madrid stocks surged past Ibex resistance at 7,000 in mid-afternoon trade on Wednesday, fuelled by buyers of banks ahead of first half results announcements, dealers said.
Renewed bono strength also underpinned stocks, they added.
However price rises were exaggerated in some shares by thinner than usual turnover.
The Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 81.26 points, 1.14 percent, to 7,220.36.
BBV was up 2.29 percent to 12,930 pesetas and Santander was up 2.43 percent to 4,840 pesetas.

"People are expecting very good results from Santander and BBV in particular. BBV also has an upcoming (three-for-one) share split (on July 19). We have target prices for BBV at 13,500 pesetas and Santander at 5,300 pesetas", said a dealer at Banesto.
Banesto expects BBV to post a 40 percent rise in first half profits, and an around 30 percent gain for Santander, he said.
Dealers said upside for utilities may now be capped, with interest in banks also foreseeably boosted by switching from electricity firms.
